entries.title: Psalms 27:1
segments:
PSALM XXVII. 
 
  David declares his confidence in God, ver. 1-3.   His desire to be in the house of God, ver. 4-6.   He prays for light and salvation, ver. 7-12.   And exhorts others to wait upon God, ver. 13, 14.   A psalm of David.

entries.title: Psalms 27:2
segments: V. 2. Light-My counsellor in all my difficulties, and my comforter and deliverer in all my distresses.  Strength-The supporter and preserver of my life.

entries.title: Psalms 27:3
segments: V. 3. In this-That God is my light.

entries.title: Psalms 27:4
segments: V. 4. Dwell. &c.-Have opportunity of constant attendance upon God. To behold-That there I may delight myself, in the contemplation of thy amiable and glorious majesty, and of thy infinite wisdom, holiness, justice, truth, and mercy.

entries.title: Psalms 27:5
segments: V. 5. The secret-In his tabernacle, into which mine enemies cannot come.  He alludes to the ancient custom of offenders, who used to flee to the tabernacle or altar.  Rock-A place high and inaccessible.

entries.title: Psalms 27:9
segments: V. 9. Away-From thy face or presence, or from the place of thy worship.

entries.title: Psalms 27:11
segments: V. 11. Because of-That I may neither fall into their hands by my folly, nor give them any occasion of triumphing over me.

entries.title: Psalms 27:13
segments: V. 13. The living-David was thus earnestly desirous of this mercy in this life, not because he placed his portion in these things; but because the truth and glory of God, were highly concerned in making good the promise of the kingdom to him.
